name: Finset
sum_image
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι]
  {s : Finset κ} {g : κ → ι}, Set.InjOn g ↑s → ∑ x ∈ Finset.image g s, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, f (g x)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : ι → M} [inst_1 : DecidableEq ι]
  {s : Finset κ} {g : κ → ι}, Set.InjOn g ↑s → ∑ x ∈ Finset.image g s, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, f (g x)
result.informal_name: Sum over Image of Injective Function Equals Sum over Original Set
result.informal_description: If $ g $ is injective on a finite set $ s $, then the sum of $ f(x) $ over the image $ g(s) $ equals the sum of $ f(g(x)) $ over all $ x \in s $. Formally, $ \sum_{x \in \mathrm{image}(g, s)} f(x) = \sum_{x \in s} f(g(x)) $, where $ M $ is an additive commutative monoid.

name: Finset
sum_bij
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset κ} {f : ι → M}
  {g : κ → M} (i : (a : ι) → a ∈ s → κ),
  (∀ (a : ι) (ha : a ∈ s), i a ha ∈ t) →
    (∀ (a₁ : ι) (ha₁ : a₁ ∈ s) (a₂ : ι) (ha₂ : a₂ ∈ s), i a₁ ha₁ = i a₂ ha₂ → a₁ = a₂) →
      (∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a, ∃ (ha : a ∈ s), i a ha = b) →
        (∀ (a : ι) (ha : a ∈ s), f a = g (i a ha)) → ∑ x ∈ s, f x = ∑ x ∈ t, g x
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {s : Finset ι} {t : Finset κ} {f : ι → M}
  {g : κ → M} (i : (a : ι) → a ∈ s → κ),
  (∀ (a : ι) (ha : a ∈ s), i a ha ∈ t) →
    (∀ (a₁ : ι) (ha₁ : a₁ ∈ s) (a₂ : ι) (ha₂ : a₂ ∈ s), i a₁ ha₁ = i a₂ ha₂ → a₁ = a₂) →
      (∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a, ∃ (ha : a ∈ s), i a ha = b) →
        (∀ (a : ι) (ha : a ∈ s), f a = g (i a ha)) → ∑ x ∈ s, f x = ∑ x ∈ t, g x
result.informal_name: Sum Equality Under Bijection Between Finite Sets
result.informal_description: Let $ s $ be a finite set of type $ \iota $ and $ t $ a finite set of type $ \kappa $, with $ M $ an additive commutative monoid. If there exists a bijection $ i : s \to t $ such that for all $ a \in s $, $ f(a) = g(i(a)) $, then the sum of $ f $ over $ s $ equals the sum of $ g $ over $ t $. Formally, if $ i $ is injective on $ s $, surjective onto $ t $, and $ f $ and $ g $ are related by $ i $, then $ \sum_{x \in s} f(x) = \sum_{x \in t} g(x) $.

name: Finset
sum_map
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (s : Finset ι) (e : ι ↪ κ) (f : κ → M),
  ∑ x ∈ Finset.map e s, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, f (e x)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (s : Finset ι) (e : ι ↪ κ) (f : κ → M),
  ∑ x ∈ Finset.map e s, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, f (e x)
result.informal_name: Sum over Image of Finite Set under Injection
result.informal_description: For any finite set $s$ of type $\iota$, injective function $e : \iota \to \kappa$, and function $f : \kappa \to M$ where $M$ is an additive commutative monoid, the sum of $f(x)$ over the image $\mathrm{Finset.map}\, e\, s$ equals the sum of $f(e(x))$ over the original set $s$. Symbolically: $\sum_{x \in \mathrm{Finset.map}\, e\, s} f(x) = \sum_{x \in s} f(e(x))$.

name: Finset
sum_map'
result.signature:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (s : Finset ι) (e : ι ↪ κ),
  (Finset.map e s).sum = fun f => ∑ x ∈ s, f (e x)
result.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {κ : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (s : Finset ι) (e : ι ↪ κ),
  (Finset.map e s).sum = fun f => ∑ x ∈ s, f (e x)
result.informal_name: Sum over Mapped Finite Set Under Injection
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of type $\iota$, injective function $ e : \iota \to \kappa $, and function $ f : \kappa \to M $ where $ M $ is an additive commutative monoid, the sum of $ f $ over the image $ \mathrm{Finset.map}(e, s) $ equals the sum of $ f \circ e $ over $ s $. In symbols: $\sum_{x \in \mathrm{Finset.map}(e, s)} f(x) = \sum_{x \in s} f(e(x))$.

name: finsum_mem_image
result.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : α → M} {s : Set β} {g : β → α},
  Set.InjOn g s → ∑ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ g '' s), f i = ∑ᶠ (j : β) (_ : j ∈ s), f (g j)
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : α → M} {s : Set β} {g : β → α},
  Set.InjOn g s → ∑ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ g '' s), f i = ∑ᶠ (j : β) (_ : j ∈ s), f (g j)
result.informal_description: Let $ M $ be an additive commutative monoid. For functions $ f : \alpha \to M $ and $ g : \beta \to \alpha $, if $ g $ is injective on a subset $ s \subseteq \beta $, then the finite sum of $ f(i) $ for $ i \in g(s) $ equals the finite sum of $ f(g(j)) $ for $ j \in s $. Formally, $ \sum^{\text{fin}}_{i \in g(s)} f(i) = \sum^{\text{fin}}_{j \in s} f(g(j)) $.
